title: Capstone: Image Editor
description: Create, edit and save real image files you can open!
requirements: `class Image` owning a heap pixel buffer (`std::unique_ptr<Pixel[]>` or manual Rule of Five)
`Pixel { std::uint8_t r, g, b; }`; `operator()(x, y)` access
Save as **PPM** (`P6` binary or `P3` text) — opens in GIMP/Photoshop/online viewers
Filters producing new images (moved out of functions): grayscale, invert, blur (box), flip, rotate 90°, scale
